headline: Mutual Benefits Assurance Reports N13.89 Billion Pre-Tax Profit
summary: Mutual Benefits Assurance Plc reported a pre-tax profit of N13.89 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, alongside insurance revenue reaching N65.16 billion.
why: Mutual Benefits Assurance Plc is an insurance company operating in Nigeria, providing underwriting and financial protection services.
